items.title: CD Projekt Red Says Paramount Cyberpunk Film Will Not Retell the Game
Cyberpunk 2077 movie "won't be a one-to-one translation of the game's story", CD Projekt Red boss confirms, and boy do I think that's the right move
items.summary: CD Projekt Red joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski appears to have confirmed that the Cyberpunk 2077 movie won't be a straight-up adaptation of the game's story.
items.content:
A more Edgerunners-esque original tale from Night City looks to be in the offing

Image credit: CD Projekt News by Mark Warren Senior Staff Writer Published on Oct. 16, 2026, 3:15 p.m. 2 comments Follow Cyberpunk 2077 Since the existence of plans for a Cyberpunk 2077 live-action adaptation from devs CD Projekt Red and Paramount Pictures was revealed last week, I've been hoping it won't take the form of porting V's tale from the game to the big screen. Such a thing wouldn't necessarily be terrible, but I like my game adaptations a bit more on the original story side of things, as Cyberpunk tie-in anime series Edgerunners has been. The good news is that one of CD Projekt Red's big bosses has now confirmed that this adaptation won't be beat-for-beat retelling of 'Honey, there's a Keanu in my brain'.

There is a caveat in that the interview in question with CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski has been conducted and printed in Polish by business site PAP Biznes . A machine translation of the article suggests the exec said the following about the Cyberpunk movie:

"Our contract with Anonymous Content expired, and in the meantime, an opportunity arose to establish cooperation with Paramount Pictures, and we decided that we would conduct a live-action Cyberpunk project in a new formula. At this point, we can only say that we definitely don't want to make a film adaptation of the game. We want to tell a story in the world of Cyberpunk, but it won't be a one-to-one translation of the game's story."

Wary of relying solely on machine-translated quotes given they can result in meanings being twisted or made misinterpretable, we've run the quote by a Polish contact in order to try and root out any potential muddling of Nowakowski's words by the auto-translation. I've also reached out to CD Projekt Red for comment.

In a previous statement at the time the movie plans we confirmed, all Nowakowski said was that the studio are "excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise" and would share more info on the film "at the appropriate time".

Assuming the movie does go the Edgerunners-esque route of telling a Night City story separate from the game's tale, that's definitely the right move in my eyes. Not only would that mean its creators don't have to agonise over how to make the pacing of an open-world game mesh with a film's runtime and could avoid having to decide how square messing with players' preferred headcanons about what V did or didn't do at various points, but it gives the creatives behind the film a chance to offer a fresher tale that perhaps explores some elements of the Cyberpunk world that the game didn't give as much attention to.

Then again, to avoid earning my ire, you've also got to avoid falling into the Fallout Season 2 trap of telling a fresh tale, but being desperate to hammer as many references to a game in as possible without conclusively advancing its setting in a way that makes the events of said game feel as meaningful it should. Basically, I'm saying I might be a bit too picky to be the ideal person to be trying to please with a game adaptation for the big screen.

items.title: 'Cyberpunk 2077' Movie First Details Officially Confirmed, Won’t Adapt Game 1:1
items.summary: CD Projekt Red CEO Michał Nowakowski confirmed that the upcoming live-action Cyberpunk movie won't be a 1:1 adaptation of the game.
items.content:
By Elijah Gonzalez Published Oct 16, 2026, 10:20 AM EDT Elijah is a freelance news writer at Polygon. He was an associate editor at The A.V. Club and Paste, and has been featured in outlets like Game Informer, Fanbyte, Unwinnable, and more. He loves media in all forms, from fighting games and horror flicks to slow cinema and visual novels. He's from the Greater Boston area. News V probably won't be the focus of this upcoming flick

Image: CD Projekt Red Cyberpunk 2077 Sign in to your Polygon.com account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google Discover Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap CD Projekt Red recently announced that Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a live-action film adaptation through Paramount Pictures. While initial details were sparse, we now know more about the movie's plot.

“At this point, we can only say that we definitely don’t want to make a film adaptation of the game,” CD Projekt Red CEO Michał Nowakowski said in an interview with Polish outlet PAP Biznes. “We want to tell a story in the world of Cyberpunk, but it won’t be a one-to-one translation of the game’s story.”

CDPR took a similar approach with the Netflix animated series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners . The company teamed up with Studio Trigger, the Japanese studio behind Kill la Kill and Little Witch Academia , to tell an original story set in the world of Cyberpunk 2077 . Studio Trigger co-founder Hiroyuki Imaishi directed the series, while CDPR franchise creative director Bartosz Sztybor co-wrote the screenplay alongside Masahiko Otsuka and Yoshiki Usa. The show is returning for a second season on Oct. 20.

Beyond telling an excellent standalone story, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners helped rehabilitate Cyberpunk 2077 ’s image after the game’s botched launch. While Cyberpunk 2077 sold millions of copies after years of hype, its disastrous console release and numerous problems on PC tarnished CDPR’s reputation. Edgerunners was released in 2022 to widespread praise, drawing attention back to its source material, which had changed significantly after years of reworks and bug fixes. A movie based on the game could once again bolster its player base.

While details about the upcoming Cyberpunk film’s cast and crew are limited, previous reports indicate that producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura is attached to the project. He is currently working on a new Transformers live-action movie with Steven Spielberg and Michael Bay at Paramount Pictures. Bonaventura has executive produced video game adaptations in the past, including 2015’s Dead Rising: Watchtower and 2019’s Doom: Annihilation .

The future of Cyberpunk is heart — real characters, real stakes, and a story that cuts deeper than chrome, unlike 2077.

items.title: CD Projekt Red Says ‘Cyberpunk 2077’ Movie Won’t Be an Adaptation of the Game
items.summary: A live-action movie for ‘Cyberpunk 2077’ is coming soon. CD Projekt Red says fans shouldn’t expect an adaptation of the game, but instead something original.
items.content:
CD Projekt Red Says ‘Cyberpunk 2077’ Movie Won’t Be an Adaptation of the Game Fans of the game Cyberpunk 2077 will be happy to know that a live-action movie is coming from Paramount. The film is being produced by Lorenzo di Bonaventura, who previously worked on the live-action Transformers and G.I. Joe films for Hasbro . However, don't expect the new movie to be a plain adaptation of the story from the game.

While speaking in a new interview with Polish outlet Pap Biznes, co-CEO of CD Projekt Red, Michał Nowakowski stated that the upcoming Cyberpunk 2077 film will be something original. The company isn't looking to retread the same territory as the game, but instead do something original that is set within the same universe.

"At this point, we can only say that we definitely don't want to make a film adaptation of the game. We want to tell a story in the world of Cyberpunk, but it won't be a one-to-one translation of the game's story."

During the rest of the interview, Michal mentioned that an opportunity for a Cyberpunk 2077 movie came together after building a relationship with Paramount. As of now, the company is under the Skydance banner after the recent merging of Warner Bros.

As of now, no specific details about the plot or characters for Cyberpunk 2077 are known. Everything appears to be in the early stages of development. This isn't the only video game-related property that Paramount has been involved with in developing a feature film. The live-action Street Fighter movie recently released in theaters, which was co-produced with Legendary Pictures. The studio is also developing a live-action Call of Duty film, which is being written by Taylor Sheridan and directed by Peter Berg.

Cyberpunk 2077 from CD Projekt Red became very popular after it was released for home consoles and PC in December 2020. Following a very rocky and controversial launch, the game went on to sell more than 40 million units years after its initial release. The series also saw the release of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , an anime spin-off series released on Netflix, which was co-produced by CD Projekt Red and animation Studio Trigger.

items.title: The Cyberpunk 2077 Movie Won’t Be a Direct Game Adaptation, Says CDPR CEO as the Company Bets Heavily on Transmedia
items.summary: CD Projekt RED confirmed that the announced Cyberpunk 2077 movie won't be a one-to-one adaptation of the game's storyline.
items.content:
Exactly one week ago, Deadline reported that CD Projekt RED had negotiated a deal with Paramount Pictures to adapt Cyberpunk 2077 into a live action film. Now, speaking to Polish website PAP Biznes , CDPR CEO Michał Nowakowski confirmed the news and shared a few key details. To begin with, it won't be a direct adaptation of the game's narrative:

At this point, we can only say that we definitely don't want to make a film adaptation of the game. We want to tell a story in the world of Cyberpunk, but it won't be a one-to-one translation of the game's story.

This is indeed an interesting choice. If I'm completely honest, I'm glad for it, having already completed the game; seeing a one-to-one repeat of the same story wouldn't be as exciting as watching another story in the same universe .

By the way, Nowakowski also explained what happened with the previous contract:

Our contract with Anonymous Content expired, and in the meantime, an opportunity arose to establish cooperation with Paramount Pictures, and we decided that we would conduct a live-action Cyberpunk project in a new formula.

In October 2023, CD Projekt had indeed signed a deal with Anonymous Content , the American production company behind the likes of The Revenant, True Detective, Mr. Robot, 13 Reasons Why, East of Eden, and the upcoming Neuromancer adaptation. Garrett Kemble, David Levine, Ryan Schwartz, and Bard Dorros were set to produce for Anonymous Content, alongside Charlie Scully. However, nothing came of it . The contract clearly had a three-year expiration date, which allowed CD Projekt RED to pursue other partners, such as Paramount Pictures.

Of course, it's too early to go into any further details on this live action movie. In the meantime, though, CD Projekt RED's CEO is looking forward to a boost of activity in Cyberpunk 2077 following the imminent debut of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners ' second season on Netflix :

In 2022, when the first installment of the anime debuted, we observed increased interest in the game. This was particularly noticeable during the series' premiere, but equally importantly, in the following months, game sales continued to exceed those observed before its premiere. We hope that this time we will also be able to invite anime viewers to our game. These types of events have two effects - we activate existing players and attract new recipients.

Shortly after Edgerunners, on November 6, the studio will also launch the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game , which broke records for tabletop funding campaigns on Kickstarter. Two expansions are already planned for 2027, with the ultimate goal of setting a pace of three expansions per year.

On the back burner of the Cyberpunk 2077 sequel , The Witcher IV , and all these transmedia projects, the studio is already considering potential adaptations for its secret new IP called Project Hadar :

We're already thinking about the franchise-related things we can do around this IP. We'd like the universe behind this project to join the family of the two existing ones. Therefore, ultimately, in the context of licensing and building brand recognition, we'd like to use similar solutions for Hadar that worked well in Cyberpunk and The Witcher.

He started working at a young age for Italian websites like Everyeye.it, Gamestar.it, Nextgame.it, and Multiplayer.it before kickstarting the indie English-language publication Worlds Factory as its founder and Editor in Chief. In the last decade, he has coordinated the overall output of Wccftech's gaming section, managed PR relations, assigned reviews, produced daily news coverage, edited gaming content as needed, and delivered game reviews. Arguably, his trademark content is the long series of exclusive developer interviews that have been cited by Wikipedia and by the biggest news media and gaming publications. His passion for technology also makes him knowledgeable when it comes to gaming hardware and tech. His favorite genres include RPGs, MMORPGs, and action/adventure games.

items.title: 'We Want to Tell a Story in the World of Cyberpunk' — CD Projekt Rules Out Making a Movie of the Cyberpunk 2077 Story
items.summary: CD Projekt Red has finally spoken up about the live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie. The company said it doesn’t want to do a 1:1 adaptation of the game, instead telling a new story within the same universe.
items.content:
CD Projekt Red has finally spoken up about the live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie . The company said it doesn’t want to do a 1:1 adaptation of the game, instead telling a new story within the same universe.

"At this point, we can only say that we definitely don't want to make a film adaptation of the game," co-CEO Michał Nowakowski told Polish outlet PAP Biznes , via GamesRadar . "We want to tell a story in the world of Cyberpunk, but it won't be a one-to-one translation of the game's story."

The Cyberpunk movie is being created in partnership with Parmount, now under the Skydance banner after the recent merger . The film will be produced by Lorenzo di Bonaventura, of live-action Transformers fame.

It’ll be interesting to see how far the movie strays from the game, which featured a freelance mercenary called V who put a mysterious computer chip in their brain and ended up haunted by the digital ghost of Keanu Reeves’ Johnny Silverhand. I’d personally love them to go back, get Reeves back in, and tell Silverhand’s story before he ended up stuck in a chip.

Of course, the Cyberpunk universe — created by tabletop RPG designer Mike Pondsmith — is wide enough to tell a range of original stories. It’s fertile soil for pulling at themes of identity, autonomy, and the self as a ship of theseus to be modified and reprinted.

It sounds like a similar approach the company took to anime. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners feels like a faithful multimedia project within the world CDPR created — featuring locations and characters from the game world — but it tells a fresh story about original characters in its dystopian posthuman hellscape.

The Studio Trigger-led anime series is back on Netflix this month when Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 launches on October 20. Check out the IGN interview with the creators of Edgerunners for the lowdown.

CD Projekt also recently announced that work has officially begun on Project Hadar , its first game in its own original universe. The company has previously only played in the worlds of others, with The Witcher based on novels and Cyberpunk based on a tabletop RPG.

Elsewhere in CD Project Land, The Witcher 3 just got a remaster on consoles and PC, which saw the iconic RPG get a makeover. There were some issues with the new visuals, particularly heavy bloom in The Witcher 3 remaster , but CDPR was on the case quickly. And of course, Cyberpunk 2 is in the works, although it feels years away.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

items.title: After Spending Years Imagining Its World, The Witcher Developer CD Projekt Has Officially Started Work on Its New IP
items.summary: CD Projekt Red, the Polish developer best known for its amazing RPG series The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077, has officially finished imagining up a new world for us to play in. The “world vision” stage for its new IP, Project Hadar, has been completed and work has officially begun on turning those concepts into a video game.
items.content:
CD Projekt Red, the Polish developer best known for its amazing RPG series The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077 , has officially finished imagining up a new world for us to play in. The “world vision” stage for its new IP, Project Hadar, has been completed and work has officially begun on turning those concepts into a video game.

"This has been our biggest undertaking to date, taking us several years, but at this point we can say we have a coherent vision for this world and its key elements,” said Joint CEO Michał Nowakowski . “The team has begun work on the game, although it's not yet in pre-production.”

In September, CD Projekt Red said it was staffing up for Project Hadar, with a team over 30 strong with plans "to hire more, up to 50 developers by the end of this year. But what is it? In June, a new job advert teased what to expect , calling for an engineering director who would help “push the envelope for the next, immersive game in the Hadar world, creating an emotional, open-world experience that will stay with gamers.” Open-world confirmed!

CD Projekt Red is of course currently hard at work making The Witcher 4, which is the next game on the studio’s slate due out 2028. Before that, though, a third major expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, titled Songs of the Past, is scheduled for release next year. Developed by Fool’s Theory, a team of former CD Projekt developers, the expansion aims to bridge the gap between The Witcher 3 and the next game in the series, starring Geralt’s adopted daughter, Ciri.

After that comes Cyberpunk 2, the follow-up to Cyberpunk 2077. And let's not forget that CD Projekt intends to release the new The Witcher 3 trilogy in the space of six years. Assuming CD Projekt hits 2028 for The Witcher 4, and the company sticks to its ambitious release strategy for this new The Witcher trilogy , we could see The Witcher 5 in 2031 and The Witcher 6 in 2034. Where Hadar fits in with all that is anyone's guess.

We know nothing about Project Hadar’s world or setting, but it’ll be cool to see what the wonderful minds at CDPR think up — especially as it’ll be designed first and foremost to support a sprawling RPG. I do selfishly wish CDPR would do one more license though. Give us a good Game of Thrones video game. Please. You could call it Project Hodor.

The next series of the anime based on CDPR and Pondsmith’s shared world is coming to Netflix on October 20. You can check out our interview with the creator of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 for the lowdown.

Elsewhere in CD Project Land, The Witcher 3 just got a remaster on consoles and PC, which saw the iconic RPG get a makeover to tide people over until the expansion. There were some issues with the new visuals, particularly heavy bloom in The Witcher 3 remaster , but CDPR fixed its prized goose sharpish.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

items.title: Cyberpunk 2 game director says the new RPG keeps expanding past its original vision as more devs contribute to the massive RPG
items.summary: The game director behind Cyberpunk 2 explains how the upcoming RPG keeps evolving past its original vision at CDPR's new studio.
items.content:
Games Blog About Us Careers Tutorials FAQs All News Features Guides Reviews Fortnite Marvel Rivals Arc Raiders Tutorials FAQs Cyberpunk 2 game director says the new RPG keeps expanding past its original vision as more devs contribute to the massive RPG Published:

Whereas Cyberpunk 2077 was subject to an incredibly siloed development, Cyberpunk 2 is being made in a much more collaborative state at CD Projekt Red’s new Boston-based studio . While the sequel will likely maintain the first-person cinematic focus of its predecessor , game director Gabe Amatangelo explains that the game keep evolving and changing.

As part of the game’s more collaborative development, which the team started with the creation of Cyberpunk 2077 ’s Phantom Liberty expansion, Cyberpunk 2 is no longer a few higher-up developer’s vision. Instead, everyone is working together, throwing in ideas, and testing experimental new features.

“I had the idea of Cyberpunk 2 in the beginning, but it evolves as I involve more people. And it evolves as I empower the team and individuals within them to contribute. It becomes something else, right?” Amatangelo explained in a new blog post .

While the original, still-mysterious, idea for the sequel started off as Amatangelo’s idea, new developers are adding, expanding, and evolving it way past its conception. “It becomes this thing that I’ve shepherded, but it’s ultimately a reflection of the team’s hearts and souls,” the game director added.

The game director explained that the more collaborative development of the sequel means allowing developers to feel comfortable when they get it right or when an idea doesn’t fit. “I had a lot of people saying, ‘Oh, cyberpunk means this.’ ‘Cyberpunk means that,’” he said. “And I said, ‘Yes! You’re all right and you’re all wrong!’ Punk means different things to different people, but the core is the ability to pose questions — to ask why.”

As the team continues to grow and new voices get thrown into the mix, Cyberpunk 2 continues to expand and change in new ways, becoming a representation of the entire team’s thoughts, feelings, and ideals. “There is a shared responsibility and shared ownership over what we’re making,” he said. “And we all get along; there’s a real camaraderie.”

It’s still unknown what the actual scope of Cyberpunk 2 is, although the game will seemingly allow players to go out of Night City to explore a messed up city based on Chicago. We also know that the game will be built on Unreal Engine 5 instead of the original game’s RED Engine , as CDPR wanted to move away from maintaining its own tools.

With The Witcher 4 likely planned to release in either 2027 or 2028, Cyberpunk 2 is likely not scheduled to launch until 2030, or even later. It’s going to be a long wait, similarly to the first game, but it will hopefully be another fantastic RPG, albeit hopefully less troubled on launch this time.

Lewis White is a veteran games journalist with over a decade in the field. Starting with beloved Xbox website ICXM/XboxMAD, Lewis became the Gaming Editor at MSPoweruser before becoming the Editor in Chief of StealthOptional and Gfinityesports. Lewis later jumped to By Gamers For Gamers where he jumped to become EIC of VideoGamer and the host of the New VideoGamer Podcast prior to the website’s acquisition.

Over the years, Lewis has also seen long-form investigative pieces published in outlets such as Eurogamer, PCGamesN, Wireframe, Retro Gamer, Nintendo Life, and EDGE. Now, as the Editor in Chief of FRVR Blog, Lewis strives to bring the same level of quality journalism with interview-led content to the site in both written and audio form with the FRVR Podcast.

With a First Degree BA Hons in Games Journalism and Public Relations, Lewis has been a stable part of the British games press for over a decade, and has frequently displayed his love of Halo, The Elder Scrolls, Fallout, and other games pretty much everywhere he’s worked. And FRVR is no different.

items.content:
Login without a password Sign In Forgot your password? Forgot your username? News HARDWARE DroidDeck launches Cyberpunk 2077 on Android at 60 FPS Maxim Boldson HARDWARE October 15 2026 Views: 1391 Mobile software developers have unveiled the DroidDeck project, which brings the full SteamOS user interface and PC game launcher to Android devices. Unlike popular cloud gaming solutions or remote streaming from a home computer, this utility enables fully local execution of projects compiled for the x86 architecture. The application's architecture is based on the Proton and FEX translation layers, enabling games to run directly on the mobile chipset's computing power without the need for device reflashing or root access. The interface fully replicates the original Big Picture mode, providing access to the overlay system panels, frame rate monitoring, built-in upscalers, and settings for connected controllers.

To ensure stable launch and operation of applications, the developers have published a detailed list of technical requirements:

During practical benchmarks on modern flagship devices, the project demonstrated high performance in real-world gaming scenarios. Cyberpunk 2077 With medium graphics presets, the average frame rate reaches 60 FPS on current mobile chips. Classic titles like The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition run at 60 FPS at 720p with medium graphics settings, while Left 4 Dead 2 maintains a stable frame rate of 120 FPS at high quality settings. To prevent thermal throttling, the system includes manual load balancing and disabling of some processor cores. Additionally, the utility's functionality includes image scaling using AMD FSR 1, Snapdragon GSR, and NVIDIA NIS algorithms, as well as frame generation up to 4X using Lossless Scaling.

Droid Deck requires an Android device with an Adreno 730 GPU or a newer compatible solution. Google Tensor Graphics and Samsung Exynos Xclipse are currently not supported. Additionally, at least 3 GB of free space is required to install the Linux runtime used by the app. Therefore, Droid Deck is primarily targeted at compatible smartphones with Adreno graphics and remains a limited-game solution for now. A demo of Batman: The Telltale Series confirms the ability to run this particular game on the Samsung Galaxy S24. Ultra, but does not mean compatibility with the entire Steam library.

items.content:
Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

  • Disabled NPC collision, which will make it easier to position NPCs on top of other objects with collision (e.g. on car hoods).

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where the Yaiba Semimaru could flip over during the chase, preventing the player from entering it.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - It's no longer possible to trigger the quest if River died during The Hunt.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Players can now acquire the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru through AUTOFIXER even if they failed The Hunt, which normally unlocks the side quest where the vehicle is obtained.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed an issue where the proxy interface UI in the Yaiba showroom is cut off when the "Larger HUD Elements" setting is enabled.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Various fixes for fluff vendors.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Fixed an issue where NVIDIA Reflex could be disabled while DLSS Frame Generation was enabled, causing the screen to turn pink.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Path Tracing didn't activate properly in certain scenarios.

    [/*]

Mac-specific

  • Fixed an issue where changing graphics presets on Mac set Screen Space Reflections to a higher setting compared to the equivalent presets on PC.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing a permanent white screen when Frame Generation is enabled while entering the braindance in The Information.

    [/*]

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]

items.content:
Surviving the City of Dreams is tough, but a choom at your side can make all the difference.

In our latest It’s All About You episode, we’re celebrating all of our iconic duos living on the edge! Night City wouldn’t shine quite so bright without them. 

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners in the most creative ways possible. Don't forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY. See you in the next episode!

items.title: Update 2.3 Patch Notes
items.summary: Update 2.3 lands tomorrow! Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as sup
items.content:
Update 2.3 lands tomorrow!

Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as support for AMD FSR 3.1 Frame Generation, Intel XeSS 2.0 and HDR10+ Gaming, among others.

Update 2.3 also brings Cyberpunk 2077 to a whole new platform: Mac with Apple silicon! If you already own the game on Steam, you can play it on your compatible device. To find out whether your Mac can run Cyberpunk 2077, please check the official requirements.

Read the list of changes for more info:

Vehicles

  • Added 4 new vehicles, including several Side Jobs tied to acquiring them:

    • Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Hunt and The Beast In Me).

      An additional side job unlocks the CrystalCoat™ feature for it.

      [/*]

    • Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred"

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Beast in Me: Badlands, The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo, Transmission, and Search and Destroy)."

      [/*]

    • Yaiba ASM-R250 Muramasa

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, purchase 1 Yaiba vehicle, purchase at least 3 vehicles through AUTOFIXER, and complete Reported Crime: You Play with Fire...).

      If you fail the side job, the vehicle can later be purchased through AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]

    • Chevillon Legatus 450 Aquila

      Available for purchase on AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Introducing AutoDrive! This cutting-edge, autonomous driving feature will take you to your chosen destination (i.e. job objective or placed pin on the map). If you have no set destination, it will take you on a leisurely ride through the streets of Night City. Simply hop in any of your vehicles, make sure you're on a road, and hold G (PC) / Left Stick (consoles) to activate. This feature is disabled when you enter combat or when your vehicle is heavily damaged.

    [/*]

  • Implemented Cinematic Camera for AutoDrive. Hold Q (PC) / D-Pad Right (consoles) to activate. Sit back and enjoy cinematic views of Night City as you cruise toward your destination.

    [/*]

  • Self-driving Delamain cabs are now available on demand! Simply open the menu to call vehicles, then select "Delamain Cab" from the list to request a ride. This feature unlocks after completing the job Don't Lose Your Mind (regardless of outcome) and receiving a message from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ is now available for vehicles from partner brands, including motorcycles. Additionally, the infamous hacker known as Cosmetic_Troll exploited a vulnerability and created a cracked version of Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ technology for lower-end vehicles. Please note, however, that some models do not support the technology, such as heavily modded nomad vehicles and job-related vehicles.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color schemes did not work properly on the Mizutani Shion MZ1 and MZ2.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color scheme could not be applied properly to the Villefort Deleon "Vindicator".

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Added 27 new NPCs that can be spawned in Photo Mode, including Rita Wheeler, the Cassel twins, fixers, Dum Dum, the iguana, Brendan, and more.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between alternative outfits for NPCs spawned in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between V's saved Wardrobe outfits in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • Added a confirmation pop-up when exiting Photo Mode to prevent accidental exits after setting up the perfect shot.

    [/*]

  • Added more customization options to the Look-At Camera feature, including an option for only the character's eyes to turn toward the camera instead of their entire body.

    [/*]

  • Added improvements to Lighting:

    • Lights now spawn around the camera instead of the player character.

      [/*]

    • Added an outline to the spotlight mesh and an indicator when it's off screen for better visibility.

      [/*]

    • Improved light movement speed on controllers.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Added multiple new stickers and frames, including iconic quotes and stylish overlays that let you turn your screenshots into Night City postcards – perfect for sharing memories from the City of Dreams.

    [/*]

  • Improved Depth of Field and moved it to the Camera tab.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Color Balance tab, allowing you to create your own custom filters.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Time and Weather tab:

    • Weather: includes rain, acid rain, fog, sandstorm, pollution, and sunny.

      [/*]

    • Time of Day: changes the time of day within Photo Mode.

      [/*]

    • Frame Forward: advances through an unlimited amount of frames to capture the perfect shot.

      [/*]

    • Game Speed: allows in-game time to progress while in Photo Mode."

      [/*]
    [/*]

Quality of Life & Accessibility

  • The game will now detect if the player is using inverted mouse button settings and automatically adjusts in-game button prompts accordingly.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to toggle aiming down sights in Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Jobs & Open World

  • Cyberpsycho Sighting: Bloody Ritual - the "Crack the ritualist's shard" objective now properly disappears from the Journal after completing the objective.

    [/*]

  • Sex on Wheels - now properly appears in the Journal after receiving the message from Jake Estevez.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where selecting a specific dialogue option in the conversation with Bree created a nameless, iconless item in the player's Inventory.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where the button to go to the lower level didn't appear on the elevator panel.

    [/*]

Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where, when using a controller in Trauma Drama, the controllable character would default to shooting upwards instead of forward.

    [/*]

  • Players can now drop more Cyberware Capacity Shards if some within the intended drop limit were previously missed.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing automatic weapons to fire slower than intended.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the Official BARGHEST Tac Vest didn't drop from the scripted Airdrop as intended.

    [/*]

  • The level 60 Engineer perk no longer activates the EMP blast outside of combat or after entering a vehicle.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to replay the gameplay tutorial at any time via Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Added an option to tell Johnny to go away after you look at him for a short while when he appears in the passenger seat. He takes the hint and disappears as a passenger for a couple days.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the sound of V's Radioport could be randomly interrupted by the Radioports of nearby NPCs.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where History by Gazelle Twin and Trash Generation played too loudly compared to other songs on the radio.

    [/*]

  • Improved the HDR Setting screen: fixed the HDR calibration preview so it correctly reflects the chosen settings, and clarified the description of the "Tone-Mapping Midpoint" setting.

    [/*]

  • Updated the End User Licence Agreement. You will be asked to accept it again when you load the game after updating.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several visual issues with missing, clipping, or floating textures.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several localization issues in various languages.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Added support for AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 4 for compatible AMD GPUs. IMPORTANT: The FSR 4 option will not be available in the in-game settings until the supporting AMD driver is installed. Please note that the driver will be released at a later date.

    [/*]

  • Added support for AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution Frame Generation 3.1 for compatible hardware. It can now be used in combination with any upscaler.

    [/*]

  • Added support for ​Intel XeSS 2.0, with XeSS Frame Generation available on compatible hardware.

    [/*]

  • Added support for HDR10+ GAMING certified Intel GPUs. To enable this feature, your display must support the technology (find my display) and have "Game Mode" enabled. The HDR10+ GAMING toggle can be found in Settings in the Video tab.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the DLSS Super Resolution Preset would invisibly revert from the CNN model to the Transformer model after restarting the game, even though the UI still displayed the CNN model as active.

    [/*]

  • Added more detailed information to the DLSS Super Resolution Preset tooltip in Settings to help players choose the best option for their setup.

    [/*]

  • Added the ability to move the mouse cursor to a different display while in Windowed Borderless mode.

    [/*]

  • Increased the maximum save size from 12 MB to 15 MB.

    [/*]

  • It will now be possible to rebind the key used to jump out of vehicles with the Stuntjock perk.

    [/*]

items.title: Patch 2.21
items.summary: This update adds support for DLSS 4 on PC and introduces various fixes, notably to Photo Mode. For details, check the full list of changes below: Photo Mode Nibbles and Adam Smasher can now be spawned while V is in the air or in water. Fixe
items.content:
This update adds support for DLSS 4 on PC and introduces various fixes, notably to Photo Mode. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Photo Mode

  • Nibbles and Adam Smasher can now be spawned while V is in the air or in water.
  • Fixed the Facial Expression option for Adam Smasher.
  • Fixed an issue where Adam Smasher's glowing chest cyberware was missing.
  • Fixed an issue where, if Johnny's Alternate Appearance was enabled, both options to spawn him (default and alternate) resulted in the alternate look.
  • Characters spawned while V is in the air or in water will no longer snap to the ground.
  • Characters will now be properly saved in presets.
  • Spawned characters will now be visible after adding a background.
  • V's rotation and position will now be properly saved in presets.
  • Fixed an issue where adjusting the Up/Down slider for V wouldn't change their position between certain values.
  • NPCs that turn invisible after disabling the Surrounding NPCs option will no longer have collision.
  • Fixed an issue where loading a preset could cause additional light sources to appear even when disabled, or spawn them in incorrect positions.
  • Fixed an issue where the camera could get stuck on walls after setting Full Collision to ON.
  • Fixed an issue where camera settings would only apply after loading a saved preset twice.
  • Enabling a background will no longer change camera position.
  • Rotating the camera will now work properly with a background enabled.
  • Fixed an issue where the prompts for Move Camera and Rotate Camera would appear when the camera cannot be moved (e.g. when using the First-Person Perspective camera).
  • Fixed an issue where it wasn't possible to move the camera after spawning a character while highlighting the Edit Character option.
  • Disabling Chromatic Aberration in the Graphics settings will no longer affect the ability to adjust it.
  • Fixed an issue where some items in scenes disappeared after setting the Surrounding NPCs option to OFF.
  • Fixed an issue where enabling PhysX Cloth would unfreeze NCPD vehicles.
  • The rule of thirds grid will now properly adapt to the selected aspect ratio.
  • Fixed an issue where the image in a SmartFrame wouldn't be visible if accessed while V was not facing it.
  • Fixed an issue where opening Photo Mode simultaneously with Wardrobe or Stash caused the game to become unresponsive.
  • Fixed an issue where it was possible to access Photo Mode before a save file fully loaded, causing it to open without UI and block any further action.
  • Fixed other minor Photo Mode issues related to spawned characters, camera movement, controls, and more.
  • Fixed various UI issues in Photo Mode, SmartFrames and Gallery menus, including slider inconsistencies, localization errors, missing sound effects, incorrect behavior when interacting with certain features, and more.

Vehicle Color Customization

  • Fixed several texture and color inconsistencies for vehicles that have CrystalCoat applied.
  • Fixed an issue where the explanation of the spray paint icon was missing in the Autofixer tutorial pop-up after a vehicle contract was completed.
  • Fixed several minor UI issues in the CrystalCoat and TwinTone menus.

Character Creation

  • Randomizer settings in Character Creation will now be preserved after advancing to the Customize Attributes step.
  • Fixed an issue where the Piercing Color option would not be available in Character Creation after enabling piercings if V initially had none.
  • Fixed other minor issues in Character Creation, including appearance options not applying correctly, visual clipping, inconsistent UI behavior, functionality issues after using the randomizer, and more.

Miscellaneous

  • Run This Town - Fixed an issue where, under certain circumstances, it wasn't possible to deactivate the Aguilar imprint after meeting with Bennett.
  • Fixed several instances where Johnny could appear duplicated in the passenger seat during some quests when he was already present in the scene.
  • Fixed an issue where Johnny did not appear as a passenger often enough.
  • Introduced several fixes to NPC and vehicle behavior for various small events throughout Night City.
  • Fixed an issue where some vendors were not interactable as intended.
  • Fixed an issue where voiceovers on TV news channels could be missing or too quiet.
  • Fixed an issue where the Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech used a description of Quadra Turbo-R 740 instead of its own unique one.
  • Fixed the missing 2.2 "check what's new" pop-up in the main menu.

PC-specific

  • Added support for DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation for GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics cards, which boosts FPS by using AI to generate up to three times per traditionally rendered frame – enabled with GeForce RTX 50 Series on January 30th. DLSS 4 also introduces faster single Frame Generation with reduced memory usage for RTX 50 and 40 Series. Additionally, you can now choose between the CNN model or the new Transformer model for DLSS Ray Reconstruction, DLSS Super Resolution, and DLAA on all GeForce RTX graphics cards today. The new Transformer model enhances stability, lighting, and detail in motion.
  • Fixed artifacts and smudging on in-game screens when using DLSS Ray Reconstruction.
  • The Frame Generation field in Graphics settings will now properly reset after switching Resolution Scaling to OFF.
